description: This file defines internal structures and functions for handling OAuth2 tokens, including token representation, JSON parsing, token retrieval, and error handling within the golang.org/x/oauth2/internal package.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents OAuth2 credentials including access token, refresh token, expiry, and raw metadata.

classes.name: tokenJSON
classes.description: Struct for parsing JSON responses from OAuth2 token endpoints.

classes.name: expirationTime
classes.description: Custom type for handling token expiration time unmarshalling.

classes.name: AuthStyle
classes.description: Enumeration for different authentication styles in OAuth2 token requests.

classes.name: LazyAuthStyleCache
classes.description: Thread-safe cache for OAuth2 auth style per token URL and client ID.

classes.name: authStyleCacheKey
classes.description: Key for caching auth style based on token URL and client ID.

classes.name: AuthStyleCache
classes.description: Cache storing the last used authentication style for token endpoints.

classes.name: RetrieveError
classes.description: Error type representing failure to retrieve OAuth2 token, including response and error details.

methods.name: Token.expiry
methods.description: Calculates token expiry time based on ExpiresIn field.

methods.name: tokenJSON.expiry
methods.description: Unmarshals JSON number into expirationTime, handling max int32.

methods.name: LazyAuthStyleCache.Get
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the cached AuthStyleCache.

methods.name: AuthStyleCache.lookupAuthStyle
methods.description: Returns last used auth style for given token URL and client ID.

methods.name: AuthStyleCache.setAuthStyle
methods.description: Stores the auth style for a given token URL and client ID.

methods.name: newTokenRequest
methods.description: Creates an HTTP request to fetch a new OAuth2 token, using specified auth style.

methods.name: RetrieveToken
methods.description: Performs OAuth2 token retrieval, with fallback for different auth styles, and caches the style used.

methods.name: doTokenRoundTrip
methods.description: Executes HTTP request to fetch token and parses response into Token struct.

methods.name: RetrieveError.Error
methods.description: Formats error message for OAuth2 token retrieval failures.
